{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
# This ensures we only have one row per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
treatment_group = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the number of patients in this group
n_patients = len(treatment_group)

# Check how many responded
n_responded = treatment_group['responded'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_patients

# Return the results
n_patients, n_responded, fraction_responded"}
